note: [L] uses the finite identity, the common strip bound and period limits as [M] does, but `active` gives the limit identity only pointwise at real momenta. It says nothing about the derivatives of the limits, which [M] also claims.

lemma active (hv : 0<γ) (hm : Tendsto (fun i=> (m i).val) atTop atTop) (i j : Loc G 1)
   (H : ∀ l,∀ u : Site (m l),∀ q, rolls (mon u) q →
    let x := taxTone G B (-q) i
    let y := taxTone G B q j
    shop (m l) (Y i j q)= (1/2:ℂ)*(
      ((∑ a,y a * shop (m l) (hatchTrace F (.inl i) (.inr a) q)) + (∑ a,x a * shop (m l) (hatchTrace F (.inl j) (.inr a) (-q)))) -
         (1/2:ℂ)* ∑ a,x a*∑ b,y b*shop (m l) (hatchTrace (F.pay F) (.inr a) (.inr b) q))) :
    ∀ q : Momentum,star q=q →
    let x := taxTone G B (-q) i; let y := taxTone G B q j
    stock (Y i j q)= (1/2:ℂ)*(
      ((∑ a,y a * stock (hatchTrace F (.inl i) (.inr a) q)) + (∑ a,x a * stock (hatchTrace F (.inl j) (.inr a) (-q)))) -
         (1/2:ℂ)* ∑ a,x a*∑ b,y b*stock (hatchTrace (F.pay F) (.inr a) (.inr b) q)) := by

proof_context.conclusion: If the contact identity holds for the finite momentum sums `shop` at every volume, it holds for the period limits `stock` at every real momentum (star q = q).

have hi a : Tendsto (fun i'=> shop (m i') (hatchTrace F (.inl i) (.inr a) (k i'))) atTop (𝓝 (stock (hatchTrace F (.inl i) (.inr a) q))) := by
    obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := trace_spot hp h (.inl i) (.inr a); exact stock_sway hb hm hq k hl he
  have hV a : Tendsto (fun i' => shop (m i') (hatchTrace F (.inl j) (.inr a) (-k i'))) atTop (𝓝 (stock (hatchTrace F (.inl j) (.inr a) (-q)))) := by
    obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := trace_spot hp h (.inl j) (.inr a); exact stock_sway hb hm hq' (fun i => -k i) hl.neg hg
  have hM a b : Tendsto (fun i' => shop (m i') (hatchTrace (F.pay F) (.inr a) (.inr b) (k i'))) atTop (𝓝 (stock (hatchTrace (F.pay F) (.inr a) (.inr b) q))) := by
    obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := trace_spot hp (h.pay h) (.inr a) (.inr b); exact stock_sway hc hm hq k hl he

proof_context.conclusion: Each trace converges by `stock_sway`, using the strip bounds `trace_spot` (a `Firm` bound of width sigma/4).

lemma signing_here (B T : Bed) (he : Inputs S X (B.metric.acts f) (T.metric.acts c)) (hw : T.metric.safe)
    (p : Site c) (q : Momentum) (hs : rolls (mon p) q) (i j : Loc G 1) {η : ℝ} (hM : Screened (changeCue M S.kernel.penalty N) η C) :
    let U := carrierY M S.kernel.penalty N
    let x := taxTone G T (-q) i
    let y := taxTone G T q j
    shop c (changeCue M S.kernel.penalty N i j q)= (1/2:ℂ)*(
      ((∑ a,y a * shop c (hatchTrace U (.inl i) (.inr a) q)) + (∑ a,x a * shop c (hatchTrace U (.inl j) (.inr a) (-q)))) -
         (1/2:ℂ)* ∑ a,x a*∑ b,y b*shop c (hatchTrace (U.pay U) (.inr a) (.inr b) q)) := by

proof_context.conclusion: The finite-volume identity: `shop` of the change cue equals 1/2 of the two W-type sums minus 1/2 the V-type double sum.
